name: Shining Smite
summary: Adds Radiant damage to a hit and makes the target shed light, giving attacks against it Advantage.

castingTime.trigger: immediately after hitting a creature with a Melee weapon or an {ref:glossary/unarmed-strike}

stats.effect: The target hit by the strike takes an extra 2d6 Radiant damage from the attack. Until the spell ends, the target sheds {ref:glossary/bright-light} in a 5-foot radius, attack rolls against it have {ref:glossary/advantage}, and it can't benefit from the {ref:condition/invisible} condition.
stats.higherLevels: The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 2.
